name: GitHub client help
description: Help mode entries of the GitHub client plugin (help@1).
author: Brett

entries.title: GitHub client
entries.text: Every pull request of this project's repos and everything you can do with them: merge, pull main in, rebase, close, batch several into one, bulk actions, branches, commits and one git log.

entries.title: Pull requests
entries.text: Open PRs with a status chip (ready, failing, conflicts, queued), checks, commits behind main, review and linked build. Tap a row for checks, commits and actions; tick rows to batch or bulk them.

entries.title: Refresh
entries.text: Reads GitHub now instead of waiting for the next poll.

entries.title: Merge
entries.text: Merges a ready PR. With the merge queue on it goes into the queue and lands with the next green batch; it never goes around the queue.

entries.title: Pull main in
entries.text: Merges the newest main into the PR's branch. When GitHub can't (a conflict) it tries in a scratch copy, where builds files merge by themselves, and reports anything else.

entries.title: Rebase
entries.text: Replays the PR's commits on top of main and force-pushes its own branch (with lease). The old head is saved in the Git log.

entries.title: Re-run failed
entries.text: Re-runs the failed jobs of every check run on the PR's head commit.

entries.title: Ask Claude to fix
entries.text: Files a build in the orchestrator's Queue that merges main into this branch, resolves the conflicts and pushes. It never merges the PR.

entries.title: Close
entries.text: Closes the PR; its branch stays, so Reopen brings it back.

entries.title: Comment
entries.text: Posts a comment on the PR on GitHub.

entries.title: Batch merge
entries.text: Pulls main into each selected PR, merges them in order on one branch, opens one PR and runs the checks once, so they land together and can't clash on main. Clashes between them go to Claude and you get an alert.

entries.title: Batches
entries.text: Every batch with its state, members, the batch PR and any clash. Land it, retry it, rebuild it on fresh main or dissolve it.

entries.title: Land batch
entries.text: Lands the batch PR (through the merge queue when it is on); the member PRs then close as landed by the batch.

entries.title: Retry
entries.text: Carries on building the batch from its branch, after Claude or you fixed a clash.

entries.title: Bulk actions
entries.text: Runs one action on many PRs: merge all ready, close all stale, update all from main, re-run failed or label. Shows what it takes and skips first.

entries.title: Branches
entries.text: Every branch with how far ahead and behind main it is, its last commit and its PR. Delete saves the SHA so it can be restored.

entries.title: Delete branch
entries.text: Deletes the branch on GitHub after saving its SHA in the Git log; Restore there brings it back. Main and protected branches can't be deleted here.

entries.title: Commits
entries.text: The commits on a branch; tap one for its files and diff.

entries.title: Commit
entries.text: One commit: message, files and the diff of each file.

entries.title: Changes
entries.text: The files a PR or a branch changes, with the diff of each.

entries.title: Checks
entries.text: The check runs and statuses of a branch, a commit or pr:<number>, grouped by workflow.

entries.title: Git log
entries.text: Every git action in one searchable list: merges, failed merges and why, retries, branch deletes with Restore, pushes, main pulled in, PRs opened and closed, batches and bulk runs.

entries.title: Import deleted-branch lists
entries.text: Reads _deleted-branches-*.txt lists into the Git log so those branches can be restored.

entries.title: Restore
entries.text: Recreates the deleted branch at the SHA saved when it was deleted.

entries.title: GitHub client settings
entries.text: Extra repos, merge method, readiness policy (green checks, review, do-not-merge label), stale days, polling, batch retries and who handles clashes.

entries.title: GitHub client settings
entries.text: This plugin's settings under Settings → Plugins.

entries.title: Re-run all
entries.text: Re-runs every workflow run on the PR's head commit, green ones too.

entries.title: Ready for review
entries.text: Turns a draft PR into one that is ready for review.

entries.title: Out of the queue
entries.text: Takes the PR out of the merge queue; it stays open.

entries.title: Comment
entries.text: The text of a comment to post on the PR.

entries.title: PRs
entries.text: How many pull requests are in this batch.

entries.title: Rebuild on fresh main
entries.text: Makes the batch branch again from the newest main with every member merged in.

entries.title: Batch PR
entries.text: Opens the batch's pull request on GitHub.

entries.title: Dissolve
entries.text: Closes the batch PR and deletes its branch (SHA saved). The member PRs stay open as they were.

entries.title: Batch name
entries.text: A name for the batch; its branch becomes queue/group-<name>.

entries.title: Land it as soon as it is green
entries.text: Lands the batch by itself once its checks pass (through the merge queue when it is on).

entries.title: Batch PRs
entries.text: Builds the batch from the ticked PRs.

entries.title: Commits
entries.text: Shows the commits on this branch.

entries.title: Compare with main
entries.text: Shows what this branch changes compared with main, file by file.

entries.title: Open a PR
entries.text: Opens GitHub's page for a new pull request from this branch.

entries.title: Newer
entries.text: The page of newer commits.

entries.title: Older
entries.text: The page of older commits.

entries.title: Branch, SHA or pr:<n>
entries.text: Which checks to show: a branch, a commit SHA, or pr: followed by a PR number.

entries.title: Labels to add
entries.text: Labels the bulk action puts on every PR, separated by commas.

entries.title: Run
entries.text: Runs the bulk action on the PRs listed above; the skipped ones stay as they are.

entries.title: Batch merge
entries.text: Pick the PRs to land together: main goes into each, they merge on one branch and land as one PR.

entries.title: Bulk actions
entries.text: One action on many PRs, previewed first, with a result per PR.

entries.title: Commit
entries.text: One commit with its message, files and diffs.

entries.title: Failed
entries.text: Only the actions that failed, with why.

entries.title: This repo
entries.text: Only the repo picked at the top.

entries.title: Every repo
entries.text: Actions in every repo this console works with.

entries.title: Batch
entries.text: Opens the batch this entry belongs to.

entries.title: Commit
entries.text: Opens the commit this entry is about.

entries.title: Ready to merge
entries.text: Opens the GitHub client on the PRs that are ready to merge.

entries.title: Batch merge
entries.text: Opens the Batch merge dialog.

entries.title: Branches
entries.text: Opens the GitHub client's Branches tab.

entries.title: Commits
entries.text: Opens the GitHub client's Commits tab.

entries.title: Git log
entries.text: Opens the GitHub client's Git log.

entries.title: Commits on this PR
entries.text: Lists the PR's commits; tap one for its diff.

entries.title: Extra repos
entries.text: More repos to list, as owner/name, one a line.

entries.title: Merge method
entries.text: How Merge lands a PR: the merge queue (when it is on for the repo), squash, a merge commit or rebase.

entries.title: Require green checks
entries.text: A PR is only ready when its checks passed.

entries.title: Allow a PR with no checks
entries.text: A PR whose commit ran no checks can still be ready.

entries.title: Require an approving review
entries.text: A PR is only ready once someone approved it.

entries.title: Do-not-merge label
entries.text: A PR with this label is never ready.

entries.title: Your GitHub login
entries.text: The Mine filter shows PRs by this login.

entries.title: Stale after
entries.text: Days without an update before an open PR counts as stale.

entries.title: Poll GitHub every
entries.text: How often the list is read from GitHub while it is open.

entries.title: Batch auto-retries
entries.text: How many times a batch whose checks fail is rebuilt on fresh main before you are alerted.

entries.title: Clashes in a batch
entries.text: Who handles a clash between PRs in a batch: Claude (a build in the Queue) or nobody (only reported).

steps.say: Every open pull request, with what stops it from merging.
Tick a few and tap Batch merge to land them together as one PR.
Everything that happened, including deleted branches you can restore, is in the Git log.
